fields.label: Order
fields.description: Execution sequence — lower number runs first.

fields.label: Step Key
fields.description: Slug identifier, e.g. create_customer. Must be unique within a workflow.

fields.label: Prompt to User
fields.description: Opening message shown when the agent enters this step.

fields.label: Target DocType
fields.description: Frappe document type to create or update at this step.

fields.label: WhatsApp Flow
fields.description: WhatsApp Flow to send for structured data collection on WhatsApp channel. Leave blank to use text back-and-forth.

fields.label: Required Fields
fields.description: JSON object mapping fieldname to display label, e.g. {"full_name": "Full Name", "email": "Email"}.

fields.label: Completion Check (Python callable)
fields.description: Optional dotted Python path e.g. myapp.validators.check_customer_complete. Called with (session_doc, collected_data). Must return bool.

fields.label: Next Step Key
fields.description: step_key of the step to advance to after this one completes. Leave blank if this is the final step.
